design.range: Prior 20 daily bars, excludes current endpoint. Separate strict break above/return below/equal, close and low below floor.
design.anchor: Earliest strict close above each own preceding20 ceiling in fixed five-endpoint rolling search; each prior range visible at its endpoint; incomplete search unknown. Reconstruction, not a durable registered plan or older anchor.
design.path: Original anchor ceiling unchanged in five endpoints; distinguish close below, boundary, reclaim, subsequent rebreak, retest touch and close. No inferred intraday path.
design.volume: Only explicit same declared unit (shares/lots/手/股) and positive volumes compared to anchor and previous day; conflict/missing unknown, no guess or unit conversion. Explicit CSV field retained, no old archive rewrites.
design.limitations: Unadjusted declared same-source synthetic daily data; not certified exchange calendar, true frozen plan, genuine healthy-pullback/false-breakout outcome, real market, model calibration, native Node, browser or production gate. No changed official thresholds, weights, trades, notifications or authority.
